title: Lost and Found in Speculation: Hybrid Speculative Vulnerability Detection
problem: Microarchitectural attacks exploit speculative execution to leak sensitive information from processors. Current verification approaches either require golden models or fail to detect information leakages through speculative execution paths.
motivation: Speculative execution is fundamental to processor performance but creates persistent security vulnerabilities that threaten data confidentiality in modern systems.
method: Specure detects information leaks caused by speculative execution—where the processor guesses which code to run next and executes it before confirming the guess is correct—by running systematic hardware tests that try different hardware configurations while tracking where sensitive information flows. Instead of comparing results against a perfect reference design (called a golden model), it uses a Leakage Path coverage metric to guide the systematic exploration for vulnerabilities.
key_novelty: The core idea is combining information flow tracking with hardware fuzzing—guided by a Leakage Path metric—to find speculative execution information leaks without comparing against a reference design.
contributions: Specure: a hybrid pre-silicon verification method combining hardware fuzzing with Information Flow Tracking for speculative vulnerability detection
Automatic detection of microarchitectural information leakages without requiring golden models
Novel Leakage Path coverage metric for efficient and guided vulnerability search
Identification of previously overlooked vulnerabilities on RISC-V BOOM with 6.45× faster search and 20× faster known vulnerability detection

metrics.speedup: 6.45× faster vulnerability search than existing fuzzing; 20× faster detection of known vulnerabilities

limitations: Evaluation focused on RISC-V BOOM processor; generalization to other processor architectures and industrial designs not discussed.
primary_theme: microarchitectural security verification through speculative execution analysis
